<script setup lang="ts">
import { onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue'

const value = ref('')
const options = ref<string[]>([])

let requestId = 0
onBeforeUnmount(() => requestId++)
const handleSearch = async (keyword: string) => {
  const current = ++requestId
  const result = await Promise.resolve(keyword ? Array.from({ length: 4 }, (_, index) => `${keyword}-${index + 1}`) : [])
  if (current === requestId) options.value = result
}
</script>

    const handleChangeAll = (value) => {
      indeterminate.value = false
      if (value) {
        checkedAll.value = true
        data.value = ['1', '2', '3']
      } else {
        checkedAll.value = false
        data.value = []
      }
    }

    const handleChange = (values) => {
      if (values.length === 3) {
        checkedAll.value = true
        indeterminate.value = false
      } else if (values.length === 0) {
        checkedAll.value = false
        indeterminate.value = false
      } else {
        checkedAll.value = false
        indeterminate.value = true
      }
    }

    return {
      indeterminate,
      checkedAll,
      data,
      handleChangeAll,
      handleChange,
    }
  },
})
</script>

  const instance = Dialog.open({

    message: "Processing the request…",
  });
  window.setTimeout(
    () =>
      instance.update({
        title: "Completed",
        message: "The request succeeded.",
      }),
    800,
  );
}

async function awaitAction() {
  const action = await Dialog.open("Choose an action to close this dialog.");

}

function hideButtons() {

import type { DialogAction, DialogBeforeCloseRefs } from "../types";

const asyncOpen = ref(false);
const loadingOpen = ref(false);

function beforeClose(_action: DialogAction, done: () => void) {
  window.setTimeout(done, 1000);
}

function buttonLoadingClose(
  action: DialogAction,
  done: () => void,
  refs: DialogBeforeCloseRefs,
) {
  if (action !== "confirm") {
    done();
    return;
  }

  refs.confirmButtonLoading.value = true;
  window.setTimeout(() => {
    refs.confirmButtonLoading.value = false;
    done();
  }, 1000);
}
</script>

  const current = ++request

  if (current === request) status.value = value.trim() ? 'success' : 'error'
}

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import { useSchedulerDataSource } from "../use-data-source";
import {
  applySchedulerTransaction,
  cloneSchedulerEvent,
  isSchedulerEventInRange,
  schedulerDate,
} from "../core";
import type { SchedulerDate, SchedulerEvent, SchedulerRange } from "../core";
import type { SchedulerBeforeTransaction } from "../props";
const date = ref<SchedulerDate>("2026-09-09");
const range = ref<SchedulerRange>();
const fail = ref(false);
const outOfOrder = ref(false);
const requests = ref(0);
const status = ref("编辑日程会保存到模拟服务端");
let database: SchedulerEvent[] = Array.from({ length: 90 }, (_, index) => ({
  id: `remote-${index}`,
  title: `远程计划 ${index + 1}`,
  start: new Date(2026, 7, 15 + index, 9),
  end: new Date(2026, 7, 15 + index, 10),
}));
const { events, loading, error, refresh } = useSchedulerDataSource({
  range,
  requestEvents: async (query) => {
    const sequence = ++requests.value;
    const shouldFail = fail.value;
    const ignoreAbort = outOfOrder.value;
    const result = database
      .filter((event) => isSchedulerEventInRange(event, query))
      .map(cloneSchedulerEvent);
    await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
      const abort = () => {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        reject(new Error("Aborted"));
      };
      const timer = setTimeout(
        () => {
          query.signal.removeEventListener("abort", abort);
          resolve();
        },
        ignoreAbort ? (sequence % 2 ? 1800 : 200) : 450,
      );
      if (!ignoreAbort)
        query.signal.addEventListener("abort", abort, { once: true });
    });
    if (shouldFail) throw new Error("模拟接口失败");
    return result;
  },
});
function jump(offset: number) {
  const next = schedulerDate(date.value);
  next.setDate(next.getDate() + offset);
  date.value = next;
}
const persist: SchedulerBeforeTransaction = async (context) => {
  // Send the delta to the backend, never replace the full database with a loaded window.
  database = applySchedulerTransaction(database, context.changes);
  status.value = `已保存 ${context.changes.length} 项变更；查询缓存随 v-model 更新失效`;
};
</script>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from "vue";
import type { SearchResult } from "@cedarjs/ui";

const inputStyle = { width: "360px" };
const storageKey = "__cedar_search_history__";

const keyword = ref("");
const recentSearches = ref<string[]>(loadRecentSearches());

function loadRecentSearches() {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(storageKey) || "[]");
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

function saveRecentSearches(list: string[]) {
  localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(list));
  recentSearches.value = list;
}

function handleSearch(data: SearchResult) {
  saveRecentSearches(data.recentSearches);
}

function clearRecentSearches() {
  saveRecentSearches([]);
}
</script>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref, nextTick } from 'vue'
const tags = ref(['Tag 1', 'Tag 2', 'Tag 3'])
const inputRef = ref(null)
const showInput = ref(false)
const inputVal = ref('')

const handleEdit = () => {
  showInput.value = true

  nextTick(() => {
    if (inputRef.value) {
      inputRef.value.focus()
    }
  })
}

const handleAdd = () => {
  if (inputVal.value) {
    tags.value.push(inputVal.value)
    inputVal.value = ''
  }
  showInput.value = false
}

const handleRemove = (key) => {
  tags.value = tags.value.filter((tag) => tag !== key)
}
</script>

]

const treeData = ref(defaultTreeData)
const checkedKeys = ref([])
const checked = ref(false)

function onDrop({ dragNode, dropNode, dropPosition }) {
  const data = treeData.value
  const loop = (data, key, callback) => {
    data.some((item, index, arr) => {
      if (item.key === key) {
        callback(item, index, arr)
        return true
      }
      if (item.children) {
        return loop(item.children, key, callback)
      }
      return false
    })
  }

  loop(data, dragNode.key, (_, index, arr) => {
    arr.splice(index, 1)
  })

  if (dropPosition === 0) {
    loop(data, dropNode.key, (item) => {
      item.children = item.children || []
      item.children.push(dragNode)
    })
  } else {
    loop(data, dropNode.key, (_, index, arr) => {
      arr.splice(dropPosition < 0 ? index : index + 1, 0, dragNode)
    })
  }
}

  const list = []

}

      const result = []
      for (let i = start; i < end; i++) {
        result.push(i)
      }
      return result
    }

    function getDisabledTime(date: any) {
      return {
        disabledHours: () => range(6, 24),
        disabledMinutes: () => range(30, 60),
        disabledSeconds: () => range(30, 60),
      }
    }
    return {
      dayjs,
      getDisabledTime,
    }
  },
})

}

const status = ref<'validating' | 'success' | 'error'>()

async function validate() {

  const value = model.account
  status.value = 'validating'

  }
}

<script setup>
import { h, onBeforeUnmount, resolveComponent } from 'vue'
import { Message } from '@maplejs/maple-ui'

function createMessage(type) {
  if (type === 'time') {
    Message({
      content: '这是一条消息提示',
      duration: 1000,
    })
  }

  if (type === 'position') {
    Message({
      content: '这是一条消息提示',
      position: 'bottom',
    })
  }

  if (type === 'icon') {
    Message.info({
      content: '这是一条消息提示',
      icon: () => h(resolveComponent('MIconHeart'), { style: { paddingRight: '12px' } }),
    })
  }

  if (type === 'action') {
    const customMessage = Message({
      content: 'Hello, Maple',
      action: () =>
        h(
          resolveComponent('MpButton'),
          { size: 'sm', status: 'primary', onClick: () => customMessage.close() },
          { default: () => '关闭' },
        ),
    })
  }

  if (type === 'closable') {
    Message({
      content: '这是一条消息提示',
      closable: true,
      duration: 0,
    })
  }

  if (type === 'update') {
    Message.info({
      id: 'demo-update',
      content: '更新中...',
      duration: 0,
      resetOnUpdate: true,
    })

    setTimeout(() => {
      Message.success({
        id: 'demo-update',
        content: '更新完成',
        duration: 2000,
        resetOnUpdate: true,
      })
    }, 1000)
  }

  if (type === 'loading') {
    const message = Message.loading('等待中...')
    setTimeout(() => {
      message.close()
      Message.success('加载成功')
    }, 2000)
  }

  if (!type) {
    Message('这是一条消息提示')
  }
}
function openMultiple() {
  const message1 = Message('Message 1')
  Message.success('Message 2')
  Message.warning('Message 3')

  setTimeout(() => {
    message1.close()
  }, 1000)
}
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  Message.clear()
})
</script>
